translations.translatedText: # Radio | Clear News | Saturday 21.10.2023
Help for Gaza. Rapid tram. Tourist city Helsinki. Storm in Europe. The weather in Finland.
## Help for Gaza

![The first aid convoy to Gaza got through today via the Rafah border crossing.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6025,h_3389,x_0,y_512/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11895066533b979eeb7b/1697888755)
Open image viewer
Aid convoys to Gaza have started. Photo: EPA-EFE
Aid has been taken to Gaza. About 20 lorries took food, water and medicines to Gaza.
Aid organisations remind people that much more help is still needed. The first aid convoy did not include any fuel.

The war has caused a lot of suffering for the people of Gaza. The residents lack everything, because Israel has closed the borders of Gaza. Gaza is on the Mediterranean coast, on the border between Israel and Egypt.
The war began when the Palestinian militant group Hamas attacked Israel from Gaza 2 weeks ago. Many thousands of people have died in the war.
## Rapid tram
![A rapid tram stands at the Keilaniemi stop.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2556,h_1437,x_0,y_260/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-117417765099c417cf2a/1695128716)
Open image viewer
The rapid tram started running on Saturday. Photo: Ronnie Holmberg / Yle
A new rapid tram has started running in the Helsinki region. The tram's number is 15.
The new tram line runs between Itäkeskus in Helsinki and Keilaniemi in Espoo. The route is 25 kilometres long.
The speed of the rapid tram is up to 70 kilometres per hour. The rapid tram has good connections to the metro, commuter trains and buses.
Espoo is Finland's 3rd tram city. Tram traffic already runs in Helsinki and Tampere.
## Helsinki, a tourist city

![An aerial photo of Senate Square and the Government Palace.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1187896652f9293365b4/1716224077)
Open image viewer
People of Helsinki are friendly to tourists. Photo: Retu Liikanen / Yle
Tourists think Helsinki is a friendly city.
In a reader poll of an international online travel industry magazine, Helsinki was the 4th friendliest city.
According to the magazine's readers, only Dublin and Cork in Ireland and Siena in Italy are friendlier than Helsinki.
Nina Vesterinen, the tourism manager of the City of Helsinki, says that tourists like the friendliness of ordinary Helsinki people.
Tourists can also be confident that it is safe to use services in Helsinki. Finns' honesty is also part of friendliness, says Vesterinen.
In addition, many people in Helsinki have good language skills. Often a tourist gets service even in their own mother tongue.
## Storm in Europe
![Storm in Scotland.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5330,h_2992,x_0,y_213/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-118922865326eefae74b/1697902039)
Open image viewer
The storm has hit Britain, for example. Photo: ANDY BUCHANAN / Lehtikuva
There has been a storm in Europe. The storm has caused heavy rain and floods.
People have died in the storm in Britain and Germany, at least.
In Denmark many towns have been without electricity because of the storm. Danes have also been moved to safety, away from the path of the storm.
## The weather in Finland
![Sunday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-11895466533ee2c0886a/1697902155)
Open image viewer
Here in Finland, Sunday is a cloudy day in the south. In places a little rain may fall.
Sunny weather continues on Sunday in the north.
The temperature on Sunday is about 5 degrees in the south and 1 or 2 degrees in the middle of the country. In Lapland the temperature is at zero or a little below freezing.
